sentences.text: When the klaxon sounds, everything stops—welders lift their visors, the crane freezes mid-lift, and the floor goes quiet. Deeper down the soil turns anaerobic and blue-grey, which is why any steel survived at all. I've welded hull seams for eleven years, and my hands still shake a little when the crane passes overhead. Nine bare chassis sat in line for turret installation, but only one crane operator was scheduled before noon. We used to hand-fit the armor skirts with mallets; now a laser gauge tells us within a tenth of a millimeter. Under the floodlights, the half-finished chassis looked less like a war machine and more like a beached steel whale. A hairline crack in the mantlet casting sent the whole batch back to the foundry, three weeks of schedule gone. Lifting straps rated for sixty tonnes arrived by lorry, along with a very nervous insurance assessor. Her ultrasonic probe traced the seam twice; the second pass found the void the first had missed. Every hull that leaves this building carries a small stamped plate with the welder's initials beside the serial number. You learn fast on this floor that a dropped washer inside a turret race can cost a week of rework. Procedure 41-C requires two inspectors to witness the seating of the turret race before any fasteners are installed. Crane four to floor: lowering the turret in thirty seconds, clear the ring. Corrosion had welded the hatch shut, so the team documented the interior with a borescope. The shift supervisor taped the rejection slip to the chassis and told nobody to touch it until the metallurgist arrived. Careful stratigraphy matters more than speed here — the burn layer above the hull dates the engagement. The turret ring, wedged solid with compacted chalk, refused the crane's first pull. Next quarter the plant will add a second overhead crane, so turret drops won't bottleneck the afternoon shift anymore. Did the retreating column scuttle it, or did the flood plain simply swallow the wreck? Conservation staff will bathe the recovered tracks in tannic acid before any display date is set. What is the meaning of the word tank?
